title: Ivo and the Confession
author: R. M. Whitlock
blurb: Oscar Thackeray, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
